latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of RevOps expert skill for revenue operations process design.

- Provides a complete lead lifecycle framework, including detailed stage definitions and handoff SLAs.
- Outlines best practices for MQL definition, lead scoring (fit and engagement), and negative scoring.
- Includes routing models (round-robin, territory, account-based, skill-based) with guidance on speed-to-lead and fallback rules.
- Offers pipeline stage templates with required fields and exit criteria for each stage.
- Emphasizes core RevOps principles: single system of record, process alignment, "define before automate," and regular measurement of handoffs.
